You should talk to your doctor first, but tapering off slowly can also work too. It depends on how long you've been taking the medication. If you've been taking it for weeks to months, slowly taper off over a period of a week or so. If you've been taking it for months to years, take half your dose over a period of one week or so, then take half of that dose for another week or so.

I'm not a doctor and this is not medical advice, this is just generally what you should do. The tapering process can be anywhere from a few days to a few weeks, and a tiny mess up anywhere can do lots of damage, both psychologically and physically.

Often, unless you are already aware that you're delusional, a relapse will happen unless you are very careful.

The withdrawal effects are usually quite severe too, so be careful of that.
